note_tweet.text:
Muse by Meta may be the best new product of the year

- character design is brilliant. cute = trustworthy. customization is easy too.
- clean, simple, beautiful. love the MD file visual design
- REALLY FAST. and executes all the cutting edge agentic flows (esp with browsers) well
- amazing design choices everywhere: thinking, permissions, etc out of the way on sidebar, ideas, side chats, feed & goals are lovely new concepts, pinned sites on left nav
- great choice in initial use cases and connectors: health, 1pass, opentable, productivity, finances, etc. gets people right to a delightful moment quickly
- native instagram and other meta product integrations are a real edge, no one else has it. can make a dent in the market with this alone
- security emphasis at launch was brilliant given real concerns with growing agent capabilities

but
- everyday people don't know what md means in soul.md etc
- opening is a little stale and impersonal. default the agent's vibe to the user based on age/location - funnier, more playful without going overboard on how much it knows
- the feed idea is brilliant but content feels irrelevant to me so far
- not clear when to use a side chat vs the main one

its early, but I think this is the best new consumer product release from a big company I've ever seen. 

everything from design to speed and performance are absolutely top notch. 

but what really stands out is the calculated beta meta took introducing new patterns here that ultimately paid off.

it feels like the team synthesized 2 years of experimentation in UX paradigms across the industry into a few extremely legible and intuitive features.

goals in particular is brilliant because it not only helps the agent figure out how to help the user but it also helps the user figure out themselves. ultimately the reason anyone uses ANY productivity tool is to become a better person of themselves. better is usually across a few areas that Muse nails explicitly.

social media has been controversial in its impact on peoples lives. I know Meta has been pushing for "time well spent" for a long time. 

this may finally be the app that truly changes the lives of billions of people around the world.

congrats team!
